pending_cases.reason: Several records in scope are combined shift/brake units. The brake_shift_combined_control family already exists; the move needs the assignment queue and product evidence, not a reading of the title.
Titles carry manufacturer codes while model and manufacturer_sku are empty in almost every record. Identity is resolved in the product, never in a second store here.
Some titles spell out Index or Friccion. The actuation mode is a property of the control and is filled from the package or the manual, never from the title.
A design or family name in a title says nothing about a chain stabiliser; derailleur_clutch stays unknown until a document declares it.
Titles declare two or three clamp diameters. Whether the reduction ships in the box is a fact of the package and is not inferred from the range written in the name.
Directed OEM relations and the real editor round are not exercised by this packet.
Range and ownership validation does not authenticate a document, resolve a product identity or approve a complete assembly.
